# Technical Debt

## Debt

Describe the maintainability, complexity, quality, or operability liability.

## Current impact

Describe the concrete cost or limitation caused by the debt.

## Cause / history

Describe why the debt exists, where known.

## Evidence

Link code, tests, incidents, measurements, or repeated work demonstrating the debt.

## Scope

Define the bounded area to remediate.

## Proposed remediation

Describe the intended improvement without unnecessary redesign.
